issues.explanation: Dangling edge references p1_shc_equation, which does not exist as a node; the real specific heat capacity equation node is p3_shc_equation. This is a duplicate/misreferenced concept causing a dangling edge.

p1_rp1_procedure and p3_rp1_procedure both describe the RP1 specific heat capacity practical procedure (measuring mass, energy input, temperature change) with overlapping practicalIds:[1]; likewise p1_rp1_calculation duplicates p3_rp1_calc_shc. These should be merged into a single set of nodes (kept in Topic 3 alongside shc concepts) rather than existing as separate near-identical nodes in Topic 1 and Topic 3.

This node duplicates the general falling-object GPE/KE practical concept; it has an edge from p0_at1_length_mass_time_volume_temp added redundantly alongside its original prerequisites p1_gpe_equation/p1_ke_equation, but never actually depends on AT1 measurement literacy directly being wired consistently. Keep single consistent prerequisite path.

There are multiple near-duplicate AT1 'measuring length/mass/time/temperature' nodes generated separately across the batch (p0_at1_measure_length_temp, p0_at1_mass_time_temp, p0_at1_length_mass_time_volume_temp, p0_at1_length_mass_time) which represent the same underlying apparatus-use skill and should be consolidated into one canonical AT1 node to avoid fragmented, redundant prerequisites across topics.

Difficulty values are present and vary across nodes/edges, so no global default-value issue was found; however several duplicate-topic nodes (e.g. p1_rp1_procedure vs p3_rp1_procedure) carry inconsistent difficulty ratings (0.4 vs 0.4, 0.5 vs 0.4) for what should be the same lesson, which is a symptom of the duplication rather than genuine differentiated judgement.

upsertNodes.label: RP1 procedure: measuring temperature rise from energy input (work done/electrical) to determine specific heat capacity
upsertNodes.objective: Carry out an experiment linking the decrease of one energy store (or work done) to a measured temperature rise in a material.
essentialPoints: Measure mass of the material sample using a balance
Supply a known amount of energy (electrical heater with known power and time, or work done) to the material
Measure the resulting temperature rise using a thermometer/temperature probe

upsertNodes.label: RP1 application: calculating specific heat capacity from experimental data
upsertNodes.objective: Use measured mass, energy supplied and temperature rise to calculate the specific heat capacity of a material.
essentialPoints: Rearrange ΔE = mcΔθ to find c = ΔE/(mΔθ)
Substitute experimental values to calculate specific heat capacity

remainingProblems: Multiple near-duplicate AT1 apparatus-measurement nodes exist across topic 0 (p0_at1_measure_length_temp, p0_at1_mass_time_temp, p0_at1_length_mass_time_volume_temp, p0_at1_length_mass_time) that should ideally be merged into one canonical reusable node; left as-is here to avoid destabilizing many existing edges beyond the scope of this patch.

Several MS/WS foundation concepts (e.g. p0_ms_rearrange vs p0_ms_rearrange_equations vs p0_rearrange_equations) are duplicated with different ids across topic 0.1/0.2/0.3/0.4 subtopics; a full consolidation pass is recommended but not performed here to preserve DAG stability within this patch's scope.
